build_proof: Per arm, after its PR opens: workflow_dispatch apk-release.yml at the PR head ref with the arm version override + prerelease=true => GitHub prerelease apk-v<version> (assets fleet-<version>.apk + SHA256SUMS). evaluator.provider_class: review-class provider (devin/qodo route) dispatched on the evidence record; this lane (apk-release) collects deterministic metrics only and issues no verdict.
evaluator.separation: Builder != evaluator (DoE separation, docs/ops/MVT-DOE-ATES-SEPARATION.md). Evaluator consumes ONLY evidence committed under this campaign's records/ after all arms close.
evaluator.verdict_gate: No arm merges to master on this lane's say-so. Selection (merge winner arm, close others, promote its version) follows the evaluator verdict + main/owner ruling. Losing arms' prereleases stay labeled prerelease.

changes: MainActivity displays runtime versionName + versionCode (PackageManager) and device SDK level (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT)

apps/fleet-apk/CHANGELOG.md created/updated with the arm version entry naming provider + dispatch route
feature_spec_frozen.delivery: one PR per arm, branch apk-doe/<arm>, title '[apk-doe] <arm> v<version>'
feature_spec_frozen.scope: apps/fleet-apk only; no edits to scripts/apk/build_apk.sh, .github/workflows/apk-release.yml, or the manifest package id

hypothesis: Provider dispatch routes differ measurably on a small, frozen native-app spec: at least one route delivers a gate-green PR whose dispatched apk-release build verifies (apksigner) within the campaign window; route is the treatment, version is its label.
metrics: diff additions/deletions + files touched vs spec scope
spec_compliance (3 frozen changes present, 0 out-of-scope files)
owner_order: Owner 2026-10-31 (this lane, direct): APK lane 'requires built by Termux MonoRepo dispatch methods' + 'Parallel versioning comparisons DoE'. probe_cap: 1 dispatch per arm (+1 re-dispatch on documented session/run failure, recorded as run 2). No silent retries.
records: experiments/doe/apk-1-parallel-versioning/records/ (dispatch receipts, per-arm metrics, EXPERIMENT record at close)
subject: Parallel versioning comparison: the SAME fleet-apk v0.2 feature spec built concurrently by 3 provider dispatch routes at 3 distinct versions (0.2.1 / 0.2.2 / 0.2.3), each producing a PR + a prerelease APK via the apk-release lane, compared on committed evidence only.
treatment_note: Route is a treatment variable: changing an arm's route mid-campaign = new cohort, never silently folded in. Rotation rule respected: distinct provider per arm, no provider takes 2 arms.
